title: Deadlock by Valve
description: A visual exploration capturing the gritty, supernatural essence of Valve’s Deadlock—blending 1930s gothic noir aesthetics with modern magical action and hero-shooter intensity. This project was crafted with a strong emphasis on visual hierarchy, dramatic lighting, and custom steampunk-mystic typography to evoke the dark, clandestine atmosphere of an occult underworld. Built using Photoshop with meticulous attention to authentic textured details.
